# AMD'S FILES IN external\ffx\ffx_api_2.3.0 (2026-10-06, the own build of AMD's frame generation, stage 1a)
#
# AMD FidelityFX SDK, public MIT source, in the SDK's own layout: ffx_api_2.3.0\ here is Kits/FidelityFX/ there.
# repository: https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/FidelityFX-SDK
# tag: v2.3.0
# commit: 60f4ea81909200d8542eca14dccb2628b763a9a3
# tree: 9db364dd6d49f71bd2026f56763001f2ad3bf783
#
# Every file is the tag's, byte for byte, AMD's LF line endings included: src\DLSS-IV\.gitattributes keeps git's
# line-ending conversion out of the folder. No file of AMD's is patched. What the build needs and AMD does not publish
# is in files of our own under src\DLSS-IV\ffx-own (the provider list, two stubs, a one-macro pix3.h, the generated
# shader headers).
#
# tools\ffx-own\ffx_manifest.py checks this list offline. The id is git's: sha1 of "blob <size>", a zero byte and the
# bytes, which is the id AMD's repository shows for the path at the tag. A file in the folder that is not listed here
# fails the check.
#
# use:
#   own     read by the own build: compiled by build-ffx-own.ps1 or by tools\ffx-own\gen_shaders.py, or included by a
#           file that is. The own build reads no other file of AMD's.
#   helper  in the folder since 2026-09-24 for dlssiv-helper.exe, and read by our probe; the own build does not read
#           it. Six more of the helper's eight headers are rows "own": both read them.
#   notice  AMD's licence and its list of third-party components.
#   record  AMD's two shader build scripts: the dxc arguments gen_shaders.py repeats are theirs. They are not run
#           (they call FidelityFX_SC.exe, which AMD does not publish at this tag).
#
# backend/dx12/d3dx12.h is Microsoft's (MIT, its notice at its head), as AMD's tree carries it.
#
# use  git blob id                                 size  path at the tag  path under external\ffx
